title: Mixed Event — You Are My Hero! — Episode8 You Are Our Hero

meta.Event Outline: On one of his runs, Tsukasa rescues and befriends a stranded cat. At the same time, a cat-themed carnival has arrived in Shibuya.

rows.Line: Meow Park

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Nyantaro!
Thanks for getting the Ferris wheel to work again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Seeing all of you enjoy the carnival puts a big smile on my face!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Oh, Nyantaro, can we take a picture with you?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
I'll even strike one of my cool cat poses for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
A cool pose...?!
I wanna do it too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're welcome to join me.
Raise one leg, and do this...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They really love Tsukasa now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, he did just save the carnival. It only seems natural they'd want to talk to him.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Oh, it's the cat sisters!
se_run_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
You two were so cute during the show!
Can we shake hands?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna shake hands with you both too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...!
Why don't you all form a line for us here?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Excuse me... You two were also a part of the show, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Us?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes, my little one apparently wants to thank the both of you...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
H-Hi...!
I was able to cheer for Nyantaro because you two encouraged me to, so...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Thanks for cheering together with me...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Mizuki
rows.Line: You're very welcome!
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I hope you all keep enjoying your visit!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: We will! Thanks, Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Bye bye!
se_walk_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Thank goodness they're all smiling again...)
<Nice work, Tsukasa☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Your show ended up being a super huge success!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Miku, perfect timing!
I was just thinking I needed to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That show wouldn't have gone as well as it did without your assistance...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much.
You really saved the day!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe! I'm just glad that everyone's smiling from ear to ear☆>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, Tenma, there you are!
se_walk_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Airi Momoi, all of you! And...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Wonderful work, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama! I didn't realize you were with them.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Yes, I wanted to thank you all properly.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: That really was a wonderful spectacle. From the bottom of my heart, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Despite what happened, you all managed to put on a show which mirrored the one we put on when this carnival first opened. No, this was even more fantastic.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: From everybody watching the show to those having fun at the other attractions, this place began overflowing with smiles and laughter.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I can say with certainty that I'm never going to forget this day.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Thank you all for saving my carnival.
I couldn't have asked for better heroes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It feels a little strange being told that after playing a villain during the show... But I'm really glad to hear it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. However, if heroes are people who strive to make others smile...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then I believe all the joy you've brought with this carnival makes you a hero as well, Mr. Inuyama!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You disappeared before the show started...
Where were you all this time?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Ah, he was actually right near the Ferris wheel the entire time.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
He seemed worried about it being stopped...
But now that he knows it's back up and running, I think he decided to go for a walk around the carnival.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. In other words, you kept watch as we did our show. Right under our noses, no less...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ever since I met you, each day has felt like a whirlwind for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It all began at that pond...
Then, you became my running partner, and even introduced us to this incredible carnival!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm beyond glad that we met, Nyantaro, and I enjoyed every minute of the time we spent together!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I also need to thank you, Nyantaro...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Yes, Tenma and the others here kept everyone smiling by putting on their show...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: But I was able to meet them because of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
In other words, you were responsible for making sure Mr. Inuyama kept smiling.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're a hero too, Nyantaro...
Both to this carnival, and to Mr. Inuyama!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Alright, there's still some time left before the carnival is scheduled to close. I hope you have as much fun as you can until then, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Nyantaro's started walking...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Does this mean he's gonna show us around again...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's follow him like we did last time, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's keep making fun memories together until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where to first, Nyantaro?!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!
